blocks.text: Present Continuous (hozirgi davomli zamon) — **am / is / are + -ing**. Shakllari qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 3–4-darslar), bu darsda esa asosiy savol — **ma'no**: bu zamon nimani bildiradi va qachon tanlanadi. Mohiyati bitta: harakat **boshlangan, lekin hali tugamagan** — biz uning o'rtasidamiz. O'zbekchada bunga «-yapti», «-moqda», «-ib turibdi» to'g'ri keladi: She **is working** — U **ishlayapti**.

items.text: It **isn't raining** now, so we can go out.

blocks.text: Present Continuous harakat aynan gapirilayotgan soniyada bo'layotganini talab qilmaydi. Do'stingiz bilan kafeda o'tirib «**I'm reading** a great book about Amir Temur» deyishingiz mumkin: hozir qo'lingizda kitob yo'q, lekin uni o'qishni boshlagansiz va hali tugatmagansiz. Muhimi — harakat **hozirgi davrni** o'z ichiga oladi. O'zbekchada ham xuddi shunday: «Hozir bir kitob o'qiyapman» — kafeda o'tirgan holda ham aytiladi.

items.text: Madina **is learning** Korean — she has lessons twice a week.
items.translation: Madina koreys tilini **o'rganyapti** — haftada ikki marta darsi bor.

items.text: We**'re building** a new house, so we don't travel much.
items.translation: Yangi uy **qurayapmiz**, shuning uchun ko'p sayohat qilmaymiz.

items.text: Tom **is working** on a new project for a bank.
items.translation: Tom bank uchun yangi loyiha ustida **ishlayapti**.

blocks.text: Vaqtinchalik davr: today, this week, these days

**today**, **this week**, **this year**, **at the moment**, **these days**, **currently** kabi hozirni o'z ichiga olgan davrlar bilan Present Continuous juda tabiiy. U holatning **vaqtinchalik** ekanini ko'rsatadi. Doimiy holat, odat va faktlar uchun esa Present Simple ishlatiladi (→ 2-dars). Shuning uchun bir xil fe'l ikki zamonda ikki xil ma'no beradi:

rows: I**'m living** with my aunt until I find a flat. (vaqtincha)
He**'s working** from home this week. (shu hafta)
Today she**'s taking** a taxi because of the rain.
Bekzod **is being** very noisy today. (bugun o'zini shunday tutyapti)

blocks.text: Oxirgi qatorga e'tibor bering: **be** odatda Continuous da ishlatilmaydi, lekin «**o'zini tutmoq**» ma'nosida mumkin: You**'re being** silly — Bema'ni ish qilyapsan (hozir). Holat fe'llari haqida batafsil — 4-darsda.

Asta-sekin o'zgarayotgan holat haqida gapirganda Present Continuous ishlatiladi. Ko'pincha **get**, **become**, **change**, **increase**, **rise**, **fall**, **grow**, **improve**, **start** fe'llari bilan. O'zbekchadagi «**-ib boryapti**» ning aynan o'zi: Prices **are rising** — Narxlar **oshib boryapti**; It**'s getting** dark — **Qorong'i tushyapti**.

items.text: Your English **is getting** better and better.
More people **are starting** to cycle to work.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I am work now.» → **I'm working** now. (`-ing` tushib qoladi); «Men Toshkentda yashayapman» ni doim **I'm living** deb tarjima qilish — agar bu doimiy yashash joyi bo'lsa, **I live** in Tashkent (vaqtinchalik bo'lsagina — I'm living); «Nima qilyapsan?» kasb haqida so'ralganda — **What do you do?**, hozirgi harakat haqida — **What are you doing?**; «I'm knowing / I'm wanting» — holat fe'llari Continuous da ishlatilmaydi (→ 4-dars).

Tekshirish usuli: gapga «**hozir** / **shu kunlarda** / **asta-sekin**» so'zlaridan birini qo'shib ko'ring. Ma'no buzilmasa — Present Continuous; «**doim** / **odatda** / **umuman**» mos kelsa — Present Simple.

rows: The kids **are playing** in the garden.
I**'m reading** a book about Samarkand.

examples.title: Right now: in the middle of an action
examples.description: Gapirayotgan paytda boshlangan, lekin hali tugamagan harakat — o'zbekchadagi «-yapti» / «-moqda».

sentences.text: Please be quiet, the baby **is sleeping** in the next room.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, jim bo'ling, chaqaloq qo'shni xonada **uxlayapti**.

sentences.text: I can't talk now — **I'm driving** to the airport.
sentences.translation: Hozir gaplasha olmayman — aeroportga **mashina haydab ketyapman**.

sentences.text: Look, the bus **is coming**, so let's run!
sentences.translation: Qara, avtobus **kelyapti**, yuguraylik!

sentences.text: Why **are** you **laughing**? Is there something on my face?
sentences.translation: Nega **kulyapsan**? Yuzimda biror narsa bormi?

sentences.text: Dilnoza **is cooking** plov, and the whole flat smells wonderful.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza **palov damlayapti**, butun uy ajoyib hidga to'lgan.

sentences.text: Someone **is knocking** at the door — can you open it?
sentences.translation: Kimdir eshikni **taqillatyapti** — ochib yubora olasizmi?

sentences.text: It **isn't raining** any more, but the wind **is** still **blowing** hard.
sentences.translation: Yomg'ir endi **yog'mayapti**, lekin shamol hali ham kuchli **esyapti**.

sentences.text: At the moment Tom **is having** a shower, so he can't answer the phone.
sentences.translation: Tom hozir **dush qabul qilyapti**, shuning uchun telefonni ko'tara olmaydi.

sentences.text: The children **are playing** football in the yard behind our building.
sentences.translation: Bolalar binomiz orqasidagi hovlida futbol **o'ynashyapti**.

sentences.text: Excuse me, **you're standing** on my foot!
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, oyog'imni **bosib turibsiz**!

examples.title: Not exactly now: around the present
examples.description: Harakat aynan gapirilayotgan soniyada bo'lmasligi mumkin — muhimi, u boshlangan va hali tugamagan: kitob o'qish, kurs, loyiha.

sentences.text: **I'm reading** a fascinating book about the history of Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Samarqand tarixi haqida juda qiziqarli kitob **o'qiyapman**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **is learning** to drive, and his test is next month.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **haydashni o'rganyapti**, imtihoni kelasi oy.

sentences.text: **We're building** a new house outside the city, so money is tight right now.
sentences.translation: Shahar tashqarisida yangi uy **qurayapmiz**, shuning uchun hozir pul tanqis.

sentences.text: Madina **is writing** her thesis on climate change in Central Asia.
sentences.translation: Madina Markaziy Osiyodagi iqlim o'zgarishi bo'yicha dissertatsiya **yozyapti**.

sentences.text: These days my brother **is working** on a big project for a German company.
sentences.translation: Shu kunlarda akam nemis kompaniyasi uchun katta loyiha ustida **ishlayapti**.

sentences.text: Sarah **is taking** evening classes in Russian at the university.
sentences.translation: Sara universitetda kechki rus tili kurslariga **qatnayapti**.

sentences.text: Emma **is planning** a trip to Japan, so she's saving every penny.
sentences.translation: Emma Yaponiyaga sayohat **rejalashtiryapti**, shuning uchun har bir tiyinni tejayapti.

sentences.text: Our neighbours **are renovating** their kitchen, which is why it's so noisy.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarimiz oshxonasini **ta'mirlashyapti**, shuning uchun bunchalik shovqin.

sentences.text: **Are** you still **looking** for a job, or have you found something?
sentences.translation: Hali ham ish **qidiryapsizmi** yoki biror narsa topdingizmi?

sentences.text: Aziz **isn't playing** tennis this season because of his injured knee.
sentences.translation: Aziz tizzasi jarohatlangani uchun bu mavsum tennis **o'ynamayapti**.

examples.title: Temporary periods: today, this week, these days
examples.description: today, this week, this year, at the moment, these days kabi hozirni o'z ichiga olgan davr. Holat vaqtinchalik ekanini Continuous ko'rsatadi.

sentences.text: **I'm staying** with my cousin in London until I find a flat.
sentences.translation: Kvartira topgunimcha Londonda amakivachchamnikida **yashab turibman**.

sentences.text: This week Tom **is working** nights, so he sleeps during the day.
sentences.translation: Bu hafta Tom tungi smenada **ishlayapti**, shuning uchun kunduzi uxlaydi.

sentences.text: Usually I walk to work, but today **I'm taking** a taxi because of the rain.
sentences.translation: Odatda ishga piyoda boraman, lekin bugun yomg'ir tufayli taksida **ketyapman**.

sentences.text: My car is at the garage, so **I'm using** my father's car this week.
sentences.translation: Mashinam ustaxonada, shuning uchun bu hafta otamning mashinasidan **foydalanyapman**.

sentences.text: Our teacher is ill, so a young man from Oxford **is teaching** us this month.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchimiz kasal, shuning uchun bu oy bizga Oksfordlik yosh yigit **dars beryapti**.

sentences.text: Lots of tourists **are visiting** Bukhara this spring.
sentences.translation: Bu bahor Buxoroga ko'plab sayyohlar **tashrif buyuryapti**.

sentences.text: **Are** you **eating** less sugar these days? You look great.
sentences.translation: Shu kunlarda shakarni kamroq **yeyapsizmi**? Ajoyib ko'rinyapsiz.

sentences.text: James **isn't drinking** coffee at the moment because he can't sleep at night.
sentences.translation: Jeyms hozir qahva **ichmayapti**, chunki kechalari uxlay olmayapti.

sentences.text: While the metro station is closed, everyone **is using** the buses.
sentences.translation: Metro bekati yopiq ekan, hamma avtobuslardan **foydalanyapti**.

sentences.text: Right now my parents **are spending** a month at a sanatorium near Lake Charvak.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam hozir Chorvoq ko'li yaqinidagi sanatoriyada bir oyni **o'tkazishyapti**.

examples.title: Temporary or permanent? **I'm living** / I live
examples.description: Vaqtinchalik holat — Present Continuous, doimiy holat — Present Simple. Bir gapning o'zida ikkalasi: farqni his qilish uchun.

sentences.text: My parents live in Namangan, but at the moment **they're staying** with us in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam Namanganda yashaydi, lekin hozir biznikida, Toshkentda **turishibdi**.

sentences.text: Emma normally works in Manchester, but this month **she's working** from home.
sentences.translation: Emma odatda Manchesterda ishlaydi, lekin bu oy uydan **ishlayapti**.

sentences.text: The river usually flows slowly, but after the storm **it's flowing** very fast.
sentences.translation: Daryo odatda sekin oqadi, lekin bo'rondan keyin juda tez **oqyapti**.

sentences.text: I play the piano, but **I'm not practising** much because of my exams.
sentences.translation: Men pianino chalaman, lekin imtihonlar tufayli ko'p **mashq qilmayapman**.

sentences.text: Bekzod is a quiet person, but today **he's being** really loud and silly.
sentences.translation: Bekzod odatda jim odam, lekin bugun o'zini juda shovqinli va **tentakdek tutyapti**.

sentences.text: Water boils at 100 degrees — look, the kettle **is boiling** now.
sentences.translation: Suv 100 darajada qaynaydi — qara, choynak hozir **qaynayapti**.

sentences.text: Sarah teaches English, but this year **she's studying** for a master's degree.
sentences.translation: Sara ingliz tilidan dars beradi, lekin bu yil magistraturada **o'qiyapti**.

sentences.text: We usually spend summer in the mountains, but this year **we're renovating** the house instead.
sentences.translation: Odatda yozni tog'da o'tkazamiz, lekin bu yil o'rniga uyni **ta'mirlayapmiz**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza speaks three languages and **is** now **learning** a fourth.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza uch tilda gapiradi va hozir to'rtinchisini **o'rganyapti**.

sentences.text: The shop opens at nine, but this week **it's opening** at ten because of repairs.
sentences.translation: Do'kon soat to'qqizda ochiladi, lekin bu hafta ta'mir sababli soat o'nda **ochilyapti**.

examples.title: Changing situations: **is getting**, **are rising**
examples.description: Asta-sekin o'zgarib borayotgan holat: get, become, change, increase, rise, fall, grow, improve. O'zbekchada «-ib boryapti».

sentences.text: Your English **is getting** better every month — well done!
sentences.translation: Ingliz tilingiz har oy **yaxshilanib boryapti** — barakalla!

sentences.text: Prices in the bazaar **are rising** faster than salaries.
sentences.translation: Bozordagi narxlar maoshlardan tezroq **oshib boryapti**.

sentences.text: The population of Tashkent **is growing**, and the city needs more schools.
sentences.translation: Toshkent aholisi **o'sib boryapti**, shaharga ko'proq maktab kerak.

sentences.text: **It's getting** dark, so we should go home now.
sentences.translation: **Qorong'i tushyapti**, endi uyga qaytishimiz kerak.

sentences.text: After the operation, Grandpa's health **is improving** slowly.
sentences.translation: Operatsiyadan keyin bobomning sog'lig'i asta-sekin **yaxshilanyapti**.

sentences.text: More and more people **are working** from home these days.
sentences.translation: Shu kunlarda tobora ko'proq odam uydan **ishlayapti**.

sentences.text: The ice on the lake **is melting**, so don't walk on it!
sentences.translation: Ko'ldagi muz **eriyapti**, ustida yurmang!

sentences.text: **Is** the situation **getting** better, or **is** it **getting** worse?
sentences.translation: Vaziyat **yaxshilanyaptimi** yoki **yomonlashyaptimi**?

sentences.text: Smartphones **are becoming** cheaper, but they **aren't lasting** as long.
sentences.translation: Smartfonlar **arzonlashib boryapti**, lekin avvalgidek uzoq **chidamayapti**.

sentences.text: The number of tourists visiting Khiva **is increasing** every year.
sentences.translation: Xivaga keladigan sayyohlar soni har yili **ortib boryapti**.

examples.title: Questions and negatives: **Are** you **working**?
examples.description: So'roq — am / is / are egadan oldin, inkor — **not** bilan. Savol → javob juftliklari.

sentences.text: **Are** you **waiting** for someone? — Yes, I'm waiting for my sister.
sentences.translation: Kimnidir **kutyapsizmi**? — Ha, singlimni kutyapman.

sentences.text: What **is** Aziz **doing** these days? — He's studying medicine in Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Aziz shu kunlarda nima **qilyapti**? — Samarqandda tibbiyot o'qiyapti.

sentences.text: **Is** it **snowing** in the mountains? — No, it's only raining.
sentences.translation: Tog'larda qor **yog'yaptimi**? — Yo'q, faqat yomg'ir yog'yapti.

sentences.text: Why **aren't** you **wearing** your new jacket? — It's too warm today.
sentences.translation: Nega yangi kurtkangizni **kiymayapsiz**? — Bugun juda iliq.

sentences.text: Who **is** Sarah **talking** to on the phone? — Her boss, I think.
sentences.translation: Sara telefonda kim bilan **gaplashyapti**? — Menimcha, boshlig'i bilan.

sentences.text: The heating **isn't working**, so we're all wearing coats in the office.
sentences.translation: Isitish **ishlamayapti**, shuning uchun ofisda hammamiz palto kiyib o'tiribmiz.

sentences.text: How **is** your new job **going**? — Really well, thanks for asking.
sentences.translation: Yangi ishingiz qanday **ketyapti**? — Juda yaxshi, so'raganingiz uchun rahmat.

sentences.text: **I'm not complaining**, but this soup is a bit cold.
sentences.translation: **Shikoyat qilmayapman**, lekin bu sho'rva biroz sovuq.

sentences.text: Where **are** the kids **going** with those big bags? — To the swimming pool.
sentences.translation: Bolalar o'sha katta sumkalar bilan qayerga **ketyapti**? — Basseynga.

sentences.text: **Aren't** you **listening** to me? — Sorry, I was thinking about work.
sentences.translation: Meni **eshitmayapsizmi**? — Kechirasiz, ish haqida o'ylayotgan edim.

examples.title: Dialogue: a phone call from abroad
examples.description: Telefon suhbati: ikki do'st hozir nima qilayotgani va shu kunlardagi hayoti haqida gaplashadi.

sentences.text: — Hi Madina, it's Emma! **Are** you **sleeping**, or can you talk?
sentences.translation: — Salom, Madina, men Emmaman! **Uxlayapsanmi** yoki gaplasha olasanmi?

sentences.text: — No, **I'm** just **cooking** dinner for the family, so I can talk.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, oilaga kechki ovqat **tayyorlayapman**, gaplasha olaman.

sentences.text: — Great! How **are** things **going** with your new job in Tashkent?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r! Toshkentdagi yangi ishing qanday **ketyapti**?

sentences.text: — Quite well, but this week **we're working** late every evening.
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi, lekin bu hafta har kuni kechgacha **ishlayapmiz**.

sentences.text: — Poor you! And what **are** you **doing** at the weekends now?
sentences.translation: — Bechora! Dam olish kunlari hozir nima **qilyapsan**?

sentences.text: — **I'm learning** to swim, believe it or not, at a pool near my flat.
sentences.translation: — Ishonsang-ishonma, uyim yaqinidagi basseynda **suzishni o'rganyapman**.

sentences.text: — Really? And **is** your little brother still **studying** in London?
sentences.translation: — Rostdanmi? Ukang hali ham Londonda **o'qiyaptimi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, and **he's enjoying** it, although the weather **is driving** him crazy.
sentences.translation: — Ha, o'qish unga **yoqyapti**, faqat ob-havo uning **joniga tegyapti**.

sentences.text: — Ha! Listen, the rice **is burning**, so I have to go now.
sentences.translation: — Ha-ha! Quloq sol, guruch **kuyyapti**, ketishim kerak.

sentences.text: — Of course, go! Say hello to everyone — **we're missing** you here.
sentences.translation: — Albatta, bor! Hammaga salom ayt — bu yerda seni **sog'inyapmiz**.

examples.title: Mixed: news, trends and real life
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: hozirgi jarayon, vaqtinchalik davr va o'zgarish — murakkabroq gaplarda.

sentences.text: According to the news, the government **is building** three new hospitals in the region.
sentences.translation: Yangiliklarga ko'ra, hukumat viloyatda uchta yangi shifoxona **qurayapti**.

sentences.text: Thanks to the new metro line, fewer people **are driving** into the city centre.
sentences.translation: Yangi metro liniyasi tufayli shahar markaziga kamroq odam mashinada **kelyapti**.

sentences.text: Scientists say that the glaciers in the Pamirs **are shrinking** quickly.
sentences.translation: Olimlarning aytishicha, Pomirdagi muzliklar tez **qisqarib boryapti**.

sentences.text: James can't come to the phone because **he's giving** a presentation to the board.
sentences.translation: Jeyms telefonga chiqa olmaydi, chunki direktorlar kengashiga **taqdimot qilyapti**.

sentences.text: Online shopping **is becoming** more popular, especially among young people.
sentences.translation: Onlayn xarid, ayniqsa yoshlar orasida, tobora **ommalashib boryapti**.

sentences.text: My grandmother, who is eighty, **is taking** an English course online.
sentences.translation: Sakson yoshli buvim onlayn ingliz tili **kursida o'qiyapti**.

sentences.text: Because of the drought, farmers in Karakalpakstan **are growing** less cotton this year.
sentences.translation: Qurg'oqchilik tufayli Qoraqalpog'istondagi fermerlar bu yil kamroq paxta **yetishtiryapti**.

sentences.text: Every time I call the bank, they say **they're dealing** with my problem.
sentences.translation: Bankka har safar qo'ng'iroq qilsam, muammongiz bilan **shug'ullanyapmiz** deyishadi.

sentences.text: **Is** anyone **using** this chair, or can I take it?
sentences.translation: Bu stuldan kimdir **foydalanyaptimi** yoki olsam bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: The company **isn't hiring** new staff at the moment, but **it's looking** for interns.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya hozir yangi xodim **olmayapti**, lekin amaliyotchilar **qidiryapti**.
